oneOf.description: The command became a pending proposal.

studies.description: Study series id -> output name -> value at this bar.

AttentionDirective.description: Where someone wants a person to look, in order.

at.description: Time sent (filled in by the authority).

from.description: Who sent it (filled in by the authority; ignored if sent).

steps.description: Steps, in the order to show them.

AttentionState.description: Where a principal looks, and what they are asked to look at.

directives.description: Directives addressed to this principal, latest last.

focus.description: Last focused point (tap or hover), if any.

AttentionStep.description: One step of an attention directive.

t.description: Bar open time, epoch milliseconds UTC.

Capsule.description: The live, openable, portable presentation of a single finding.

depth.description: Depth the capsule is shown at by default.

finding.description: Id of the finding it presents.

revision.description: Number of live updates so far.

view.description: Id of the view used when the capsule is opened.

CapsuleState.description:
Lifecycle state of a capsule:
`draft -> live -> (updated)* -> invalidated | expired | approved | rejected`.

oneOf.description: Updates itself as its series change.

ChangeOp.description:
A primitive, replayable change to the document. Changes carry complete items
(with provenance stamped by the authority), so replaying them needs no presenter,
no study code and no clock: the same changes always give the same document bytes.

oneOf.description: Insert a layer into a view at `index`.
Set (or clear) a view's horizontal domain, epoch ms `[from, to]`.
Remove the last ledger entry (inverse of `push_ledger`).
Delete an item (any collection) by id.
Append bars to a bar series.

count.description: Number of bars removed from the end.

Condition.description: A condition evaluated over series (invalidation, intent trigger).

oneOf.description: Last value of a series compared against a constant.

One series compared against another, both at the last bar (and the bar before,
for crossings). E.g. SMA(20) crosses above SMA(50):
`{"kind":"compare","left":"sma20","op":"cross_above","right":"sma50"}`.
For a bar series the compared value is the close.
Free text; evaluated by a person.

Depth.description: Semantic zoom level: 0 sentence, 1 capsule, 2 marked chart, 3 full workspace.

studies.description: Study names and their default parameters.

Document.description: Everything: series bindings, views, facts, findings, capsules, intents and the ledger.

display_tz.description:
Time zone (IANA) in which times are *shown* to the user. Display only: it never
affects bar alignment or computation (K14); views may override it.

proposals.description: Proposals: writes waiting for approval, and their outcome (protocol v0).

ErrorCode.description: Error codes. Each has a fixed meaning; see `docs/PROTOCOL.md` §13.

oneOf.description: The message is not valid JSON.
The message does not match the schema (unknown field, wrong type, missing field).
`hello` missing, repeated, or unknown principal / protocol version.
The principal may not do this.
A referenced id does not exist.
An id to be created already exists.
A value is out of range or inconsistent (bad parameter, bad bar, bad range).
The item is used by other items and cannot be removed.
An item touched by the command changed after `base`.
Undo is not possible (nothing to undo, or later entries touched the same items).
Recognized but not supported here (e.g. a feature not negotiated).
A log entry was applied (the Change message).
A watched condition became true at a bar.
A proposal was created, accepted, rejected or expired.
An attention directive for the watched principal.

Fact.description: An indisputable numeric event detected by the engine. Carries its evidence.

series.description: Id of the series the event happened on.

facts.description: Ids of the facts the claim rests on.

invalidation.description: When this condition holds, the finding is invalid.

Glyph.description: A one-glance visual of meaning, not data.

GlyphKind.description: Kind of meaning glyph (initial candidate set; finalized in R3).

oneOf.description: Has it happened before, and what followed?
What changed since the last look?

Instrument.description: A traded asset: where it trades and which calendar aligns its bars (K14).

calendar.description: Calendar id, e.g. `XIST`, `XNYS`. Bars are aligned to this calendar.

Intent.description: A persistent request left by the user, e.g. "tell me if the uptrend breaks".

active.description: Whether the intent is still active.

text.description: The request as the user said it.

trigger.description: Machine-checkable trigger, if one could be derived.

Layer.description: One layer of a view: a mark bound to a series.

encoding.description: Encoding: visual channel -> field or constant, e.g. `{"y": "v", "color": "#888"}`.

series.description: Series id; absent for constant marks (e.g. a rule).

Ledger.description: The record of findings compared with reality afterwards.

state.description: Final capsule state, if any (e.g. approved / rejected by a person).

Limits.description: Limits enforced by the authority on incoming messages.

max_message_bytes.description: Maximum size of one incoming message, bytes.

max_string.description: Maximum length of any string, bytes.

LogEntry.description: One entry of the operation log.

approved_by.description: Principal id that approved it (accepted proposals only).

author.description: Principal id that wrote it (for an accepted proposal: the proposer).

cause.description: Request id of the command that caused it, if any.

inverse.description: The changes that undo this entry.

summary.description: Short deterministic summary, e.g. `"add_study rsi(period=7) -> rsi-3-0"`.

undoes.description: If this entry is an undo: the entry it undoes.

Narrative.description: A narration timeline about a finding: ordered steps, each pointing at something.

about.description: The item it narrates (usually a finding id).

NarrativeStep.description: One step of a narration timeline.

at_ms.description: Start of the step, milliseconds from the start of the narration.

say.description: What to say (one or two sentences).

Op.description:
An operation in a command: what a human or an agent asks for, at the level of
meaning. The authority expands it into [`ChangeOp`]s (the replayable form).
Ids are optional where marked; the authority then assigns one (returned in
`ack.created`). All ids in a document are unique across all collections.

oneOf.description: Add or replace a series binding (by id).

Add a study (computed series) on input series, optionally showing it in a view.
E.g. `{"op":"add_study","study":"rsi","inputs":["px"],"params":{"period":7},
"show":{"view":"main","with":"rsi14"}}`.

id.description: Id of the new series; assigned if absent.

inputs.description: Input series ids (one bar series for the built-in studies).

params.description:
Parameters; missing ones take defaults (sma/ema/rsi: `period`; macd: `fast`,
`slow`, `signal`; bollinger: `period`, `k`).

oneOf.description: Change parameters of an existing study series (merged into the current ones).
Add or replace a whole view (by id).
Add a layer to a view.

index.description: Position in the layer list; appended if absent.

oneOf.description: Remove a layer from a view by position.

Set the visible bar range of a view (persistent; for a transient viewport use
`input`). Bars are 0-based indexes into the view's first bar series, inclusive.
Record a fact (normally the engine's job).
Write a finding (a claim resting on facts), optionally with its capsule.

capsule.description: Also create a live capsule with this headline.

facts.description: Fact ids it rests on (must exist).

invalidation.description: When this holds, the finding is invalid.

oneOf.description: Change fields of a finding; absent fields stay as they are.

A person approves a finding: its capsule becomes `approved` and the ledger
records it.

A person rejects a finding: its capsule becomes `rejected` and the ledger
records it with the note.
Leave a persistent request ("tell me if ...").

trigger.description: Machine-checkable trigger. Series it names must exist.

oneOf.description: Switch an intent on or off.
Add a narration timeline about an item.

about.description: Item id it narrates (usually a finding).

oneOf.description:
Ask the engine's presenter to build a view for a finding (the agent speaks at the
level of meaning; the presenter writes the grammar). The view is attached to the
finding's capsule.

view.description: Id of the view to create or replace; assigned if absent.

oneOf.description:
Remove an item by id. Removing a series also removes the layers that draw it;
it fails with `in_use` if other items (studies, facts, conditions) depend on it.
Append bars to a bar series (data feeds).

bars.description: Bars, strictly after the last bar.

oneOf.description: Replace the last bar of a bar series (a live, still-forming bar).

bar.description: The bar; same `t` as the current last bar.

oneOf.description:
Undo a log entry by writing its inverse as a new entry. Without `seq`: the
speaker's own latest entry that is not yet undone.

Accept a pending proposal: its operations are applied now, in the proposer's name
with the decider recorded as approver.

Outcome.description: Outcome of a finding compared against what actually happened.

PanelInfo.description: One panel as seen on screen.

series.description: Series drawn in it, in layer order (e.g. `["px","bb20"]`).

Point.description:
One point of a single-valued series (e.g. an indicator output).

Warmup rule (K13): a study output always has one point per input bar, at the same
`t`. Points inside the warmup period have `v: null`; nothing is trimmed.

t.description: Point time, epoch milliseconds UTC (the time of the bar it belongs to).

Presentation.description: A finding presented at a depth.

spark.description: Small series excerpt (depth >= capsule, if the profile allows series data).

state.description: Capsule state, if the finding has a capsule.

surface.description: Surface kind it was made for.

Principal.description: A principal known to the authority (host configuration, not sent by clients).

Profile.description: The presentation profile the authority chose for a surface.

depth.description: Deepest presentation sent to this surface.

max_points.description: Maximum data points per series in a presentation (0 when `series_data` is false).

series_data.description: Whether presentations may carry series data.

speech.description: Whether text should be phrased for speech.

decided_seq.description: Log position at which it was decided or expired.

expires_at.description: Expiry time; absent means no expiry.

reason.description: Why, as given by the proposer.

ProtocolError.description: A protocol error. Written so that an agent can correct its message without help.

conflicts.description: For `conflict` / `undo_conflict`: the log positions that conflict.

did_you_mean.description: Existing ids or names close to the one given (edit distance).

expected.description: Accepted values or forms at `path`, when they are a short list.

hint.description: How to fix it, in one sentence.

message.description: What went wrong, in one sentence.

path.description: JSON pointer into the offending message, e.g. `/ops/0/params/period`.

Provenance.description: Who produced an item, based on what, and when.

approved_by.description:
Who approved it, when it entered the document through an accepted proposal
(protocol: `accept_proposal`). Absent for direct writes.

based_on.description: Ids of the items this one is based on.

QueryResult.description: The answer to a query or input.

oneOf.description: Answer to `get`: the item, tagged with its collection.
Answer to `study` with `reduce`: output name -> reduced value.

bars.description: Number of bars in the range.

screens.description: One entry per connected surface of the principal.

Reduce.description: Reduction applied over a range (warmup `null`s are skipped).

bar.description: Bar index where it occurs (min, max, first, last).

value.description: The value (`null` when the range has no non-null value).

Role.description: Role of a principal; decides what it may do (see `docs/PROTOCOL.md` §9).

oneOf.description: Direct writes; may not decide proposals.
Writes become proposals (the default for agents).
The process hosting the authority: `clock` and data.

Scale.description: A scale mapping data values to a visual axis.

domain.description: Fixed domain `[min, max]`; automatic when absent.

capsules.description: Capsules whose fact bar is in the visible range.

last_close.description: Last close in the visible range.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol of the view's main series, if any.

Series.description:
Time-based numeric data: bars, an indicator output or a stream.

In a [`Document`] a series acts as a binding: `source` says where data comes
from and `data` may be omitted.

instrument.description:
The instrument the series belongs to, if any. Its symbol lives here (there is no
separate `symbol` field), so exchange and calendar travel with it (K14).

SeriesSource.description: Where a series comes from. The core does not depend on the kind of source.

oneOf.description: Data is embedded in the series itself (`data`).
Local computation: a study applied to other series.

output.description: Which output of a multi-output study, if any.

SeriesValues.description: Values of a series over a range.

from_bar.description: First bar index in the answer.

outputs.description: Output name -> one value per bar (`null` during warmup).

t.description: Bar times, one per bar in the range.

Show.description: Where a new study is shown.

with.description:
Put it in the panel where this series is drawn (e.g. `"rsi14"`). Takes precedence
over `panel`. If neither is given, a new panel is added below the others.

SurfaceKind.description: Kind of surface a connection presents on.

oneOf.description: Voice only: no screen; answers are spoken.
No presentation at all (an agent, a batch job).

Target.description: A step of a narration or an attention directive points at something.

from_bar.description: First bar index (0-based) of the region.

output.description: Output or field of the series, e.g. `"v"` (volume of a bar series), `"signal"`.

series.description: Series id (e.g. the series whose value matters).

to_bar.description: Last bar index (inclusive) of the region; equal to `from_bar` for one bar.

View.description: A presentation recipe written in the visual grammar.

display_tz.description: Display time zone override (IANA); display only, see [`Document::display_tz`].

y.description: Vertical scale per panel, indexed by `Layer::panel`.

description: A message from the authority to a client.

epoch.description:
Authority epoch: increases every time the document is handed over to a new
authority (server -> device or back). Log positions are only comparable
within one epoch lineage; see `docs/PROTOCOL.md` §8.4.

now.description:
The authority's current time (from the last `clock`), epoch ms. Use it for
relative questions ("in the last 30 minutes").

profile.description: Negotiated presentation profile for the declared surface.

created.description: Ids the authority assigned or created (in op order).

seq.description: Log position of the applied (or proposal-creating) entry.

undoes.description: For an applied `undo`: the log position that was undone.

now.description: The authority's current time, epoch ms.

oneOf.description: A pushed event for a subscription.
Negative reply to any request (or a connection-level problem when `id` is absent).

error.description: What went wrong and how to fix it.

id.description: The request id, if the request could be parsed far enough to read it.
